_comment: Tools a project may install with `pin-runner.py install <tool>`, and PROFILES (named bundles) it may install with `pin-runner.py init --profile <name>`. DATA read from the reviewed bus commit, never executed. Add a tool here in the same commit that adds it; a profile names registered tools only (its keys: validate_profile in pin-runner.py).

check-doc-size.purpose: markdown size budgets by role; every tier, glob, exemption and scan mode comes from --config

kernel-subjects.purpose: factory kernel: is a packet a declared kernel subject, declared before its first byte; config from $FACTORY_KERNEL_CONFIG

codex-review.purpose: dispatch one codex exec review with an explicit, recorded model/effort tier

kernel-receipt.purpose: factory kernel: write or dry-run a landing's kernel receipt (a pinned group; install its members first)

kernel-config.purpose: check a project's kernel config with the loader of record (a pinned group; install kernel-subjects first)

session-checkpoint.purpose: machine-local session checkpoint hook (SessionStart/Stop; optional doctrine view + PreToolUse tick); config from --config

exact-path-add.purpose: PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell: refuse sweeping git stages (git add -A/./-u, git commit -a)

git-optional-locks.purpose: PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell: refuse observer git commands without --no-optional-locks

pre-push-ff-only.purpose: git pre-push: refuse a non-fast-forward or a deletion of a protected branch

no-unpinned-tool.purpose: git pre-push: refuse a pushed copy of a shared factory tool (run it by pin instead)

check-rule-tags.purpose: rule census: which written rules a refusing check backs; --emit-map writes a rule-map skeleton; config from --config

base.purpose: the floor every member repository runs: session checkpoints, refusing Claude and git hooks, a rule map and a throughput stub
